title: Classify post-merge observability drift as non-blocking and preserve trusted readback diagnostics

phases.objective: Keep repository inventory, evaluation, and Staging deploy eligibility evidence authoritative while classifying known post-merge observability staleness as advisory and non-blocking, and preserve fail-closed behavior for semantic or unclassified readback failures.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: main or Production receives a push and the inventory/evaluation readback workflows verify exact-head derived artifacts.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Known stale observability produces explicit advisory evidence and a successful non-blocking workflow result; unexpected verification failures remain blocking and fail closed.
steps: Verify exact checked-out head and derived-state policy invariants.
Classify only the declared stale_observability contract as advisory.
Publish bounded evidence and retain post-merge follow-up requirements.
Keep all database, migration, provider, policy Apply, and production activation operations disabled.
assertions: The advisory path requires followup_required=true and followup_mode=post_merge_observability_publish.
The advisory path exits successfully without claiming that the artifact is current.
Non-advisory verification failures still exit non-zero.
No secrets are written to evidence.
No runtime, database, migration, grant, provider, Branch Protection, Ruleset, or Production activation mutation is introduced.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A push to main runs .github/workflows/staging-main-deploy-eligibility.yml on the exact main commit.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Staging eligibility blocks on Remote MCP semantic currentness and inventory regression integrity, while observability-only drift already classified by derived-state policy remains non-blocking and cannot falsely deny an otherwise eligible exact main commit.
steps: Verify exact main identity, Staging environment authority, environment impact, derived-state closure, and Staging topology as before.
Run the registered Remote MCP semantic currentness projection as a blocking check.
Run Remote MCP inventory regression tests as a blocking check.
Do not use the full byte-for-byte inventory freshness command as a Staging deployment blocker because it includes declared observability-only fields.
Publish eligibility evidence only after all semantic and safety gates pass.
assertions: Remote MCP semantic drift remains fail-closed and blocks Staging eligibility.
Unclassified inventory verification failures remain fail-closed through the semantic projection or regression tests.
Known post-merge observability-only drift is not promoted into a Staging deployment blocker.
No database, migration, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, Branch Protection, Ruleset, Production deployment, or secret mutation is authorized by this correction.
